moments.title: August Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday provides a long weekend for many across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, with Monday, August 31st, being a public holiday.

angles.name: Travel plans
angles.copy: Long weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is officially here for England, Wales & Northern Ireland. Are you heading out or staying local?

angles.name: Relaxation focus
angles.copy: Three-day weekend vibes activated! What's your top Bank Holiday plan – full relaxation, DIY, or catching up with friends?

moments.title: Back to School for England & Wales
moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales generally reopen for the new academic year in the first week of September, with many returning on September 1st.

angles.name: Parents' perspective
angles.copy: It's almost time! For many in England and Wales, school's back next week. Parents, are you ready for the return to routine?

angles.name: Students' perspective
angles.copy: New term, new start! Wishing all students in England and Wales heading back to school next week the very best for the academic year ahead!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off is set to kick off on Channel 4 on September 2nd, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Excitement for return
angles.copy: Get your aprons ready! The Great British Bake Off is back on September 2nd! Who's excited for new bakes and Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel?

angles.name: New judge focus
angles.copy: A fresh flavour in the tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for the new series of Bake Off, starting September 2nd. What do you think she'll bring?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The pre-recorded launch show for the 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing is expected to air on BBC One on Saturday, September 19th, with live shows starting a week later.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is back with its launch show on September 19th. Who are you rooting for this year?

angles.name: New hosts/judges
angles.copy: New era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe are taking over as hosts. Catch the launch on Sept 19th!

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Elizabeth Fraser
moments.blurb: Elizabeth Fraser, iconic singer of Cocteau Twins, turns 63 today, August 29th.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to the incredible Elizabeth Fraser of Cocteau Twins! What's your favourite Cocteau Twins track?

moments.title: Happy 67th to Eddi Reader
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Eddi Reader, known for Fairground Attraction, celebrates her 67th birthday today, August 29th.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the wonderful Eddi Reader! Still singing beautifully. What's your favourite song from her or Fairground Attraction?

moments.title: Happy 80th to Barry Gibb
moments.blurb: Barry Gibb, the legendary Bee Gees co-founder, turns 80 on September 1st.

angles.name: Milestone birthday
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the one and only Barry Gibb on September 1st! The voice behind so many iconic Bee Gees hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Bee Gees tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Barry Gibb, who turns 80 on Sunday! From disco anthems to timeless ballads, his influence is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy 69th to Gloria Estefan
moments.blurb: The Queen of Latin Pop, Gloria Estefan, celebrates her 69th birthday on September 1st.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 69th Birthday to the legendary Gloria Estefan on September 1st! Get on your feet and celebrate with her greatest hits!

moments.title: Happy 29th to Jungkook
moments.blurb: Jungkook, global superstar and member of BTS, turns 29 on September 1st.

angles.name: Pop culture birthday
angles.copy: Happy 29th Birthday to BTS's Jungkook on September 1st! Celebrating the Golden Maknae with his incredible music.

moments.title: Happy 75th to Mik Kaminski
moments.blurb: Mik Kaminski, the distinctive violinist from Electric Light Orchestra (ELO), celebrates his 75th birthday on September 2nd.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to ELO's brilliant violinist, Mik Kaminski, on September 2nd! Time to put on some 'Mr. Blue Sky'!

moments.title: Happy 83rd to Rosalind Ashford
moments.blurb: Rosalind Ashford, original member of Motown legends Martha and the Vandellas, turns 83 on September 2nd.

angles.name: Motown legend birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to Rosalind Ashford of Martha and the Vandellas on September 2nd! Thank you for the timeless Motown magic.

moments.title: Happy 83rd to Al Jardine
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and guitarist of The Beach Boys, celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boys birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to The Beach Boys' Al Jardine on September 3rd! Still making good vibrations worldwide.

moments.title: Happy 71st to Steve Jones
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, influential guitarist of the Sex Pistols, turns 71 on September 3rd.

angles.name: Punk icon birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to punk legend Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols on September 3rd! Never mind the bollocks, here's to a true original.

moments.title: Happy 66th to Perry Bamonte
moments.blurb: Perry Bamonte, former guitarist and keyboardist for The Cure, celebrates his 66th birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: The Cure birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 66th Birthday to Perry Bamonte, who brought his talent to The Cure! What's your favourite Cure song?

moments.title: Happy 81st to Al Stewart
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Al Stewart, known for hits like 'Year of the Cat', turns 81 on September 5th.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the brilliant Al Stewart on September 5th! What's your favourite track from the 'Year of the Cat' artist?

moments.title: Happy 60th to Terry Ellis
moments.blurb: Terry Ellis, member of the iconic R&B group En Vogue, celebrates her 60th birthday on September 5th.

angles.name: En Vogue birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to Terry Ellis of En Vogue on September 5th! Always 'Free Your Mind' with their amazing harmonies.

moments.title: Happy 58th to Brad Wilk
moments.blurb: Brad Wilk, drummer for Rage Against The Machine and Audioslave, turns 58 on September 5th.

angles.name: Rock drummer birthday
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to rock powerhouse Brad Wilk (Rage Against The Machine, Audioslave) on September 5th! What's your favourite riff he's drummed on?

moments.title: Happy 83rd to Roger Waters
moments.blurb: Roger Waters, co-founder, bassist, and primary lyricist of Pink Floyd, celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Milestone birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Roger Waters of Pink Floyd on September 6th! A true visionary in rock music. What's your essential Waters-era Pink Floyd track?

angles.name: Pink Floyd legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible songwriting and musical genius of Roger Waters, who turns 83 on Sunday. His work with Pink Floyd shaped generations.

moments.title: Happy 59th to Macy Gray
moments.blurb: The distinctive voice of Macy Gray turns 59 on September 6th.

angles.name: Birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the one and only Macy Gray on September 6th! Still loving her unique sound. What's your favourite Macy Gray song?

moments.title: Happy 52nd to Nina Persson
moments.blurb: Nina Persson, lead singer of Swedish band The Cardigans, celebrates her 52nd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Cardigans birthday
angles.copy: Happy 52nd Birthday to Nina Persson of The Cardigans on September 6th! Still got us humming 'Lovefool' all these years later.

moments.title: Happy 57th to CeCe Peniston
moments.blurb: Dance-pop star CeCe Peniston, known for her hit 'Finally', turns 57 on September 6th.

angles.name: Dance anthem birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the voice behind 'Finally', CeCe Peniston, on September 6th! What a track to get any party started.

moments.title: Happy 65th to Paul Waaktaar-Savoy
moments.blurb: Paul Waaktaar-Savoy, guitarist and songwriter for Norwegian synth-pop band a-ha, turns 65 on September 6th.

angles.name: a-ha birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Paul Waaktaar-Savoy, the songwriting force behind a-ha, on September 6th! Take on me, take on his birthday!
